raw_segments.text: Clytemnestra. I deem not that the death he died had over much of shame, for this was
he who did provide foul wrong unto his house and name. His daughter, blossom of my womb,
he gave unto a deadly doom, Iphigenia, child of tears. And as he wrought, even so he fares.
Nor be his vaunt too loud in hell, for by the sword his sin he wrought, and by the sword
himself is brought among the dead to dwell.
